description: This file defines functions to interact with workout data, including logging a workout entry and fetching weekly workout summaries. It also defines the WorkoutEntry type used for input data.

methods.name: logWorkout
methods.description: Sends a workout entry to the backend API endpoint '/workouts/log' and returns a success indicator.

methods.name: fetchWorkoutSummary
methods.description: Retrieves weekly workout volume data and labels from the backend API endpoint '/workouts/summary' with fallback data.
